text:
Sasha: First-call quickstart succeeded locally, but after I accepted the SSO invite and switched to our org I get a 402 Payment Required on the first API call. Anyone seen an onboarding billing hang like this?

Sasha: Steps I did:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
Response (curl) returned 402 and body: {"error":"billing_required","message":"Workspace requires billing info"}
Header: X-Workspace-ID: org_00A1

Maria: Can you paste the workspace id and confirm if you can see billing settings in the Console? SSO orgs sometimes block until payment method is added.

Sasha: Workspace org_00A1. I don't see a payment method in Console — shows empty state. But the account owner is an SSO-only identity; UI doesn't let me add card (no 'Add billing' button).

billing-bot: Workspace org_00A1 — billing_status: invoice_required, remaining_credits: 0, payment_method: none, owner_type: SSO

Sam: This sounds like the known edge where SSO-provisioned owners don't get the Console billing flag set. Quick workaround: generate a personal API key from your personal profile (not org service account) and use that for the first call to finish onboarding, or have someone with a non-SSO owner role add a payment method.

Sam: Command to check workspace via API:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/workspaces/org_00A1
```
Look for "billing_status" in the JSON.

Maria: Filing an internal ticket with eng-infra. Tagging @eng-infra to investigate the SSO -> billing flag flow. @devex-bot create issue "SSO onboarding: billing flag not set for org owners" with workspace org_00A1

devex-bot: Created GH issue #3124 and linked to internal ticket INF-842. Assigned to eng-infra.

Sasha: Thanks — using a personal key worked and my first call succeeded. Leaving note: needs product fix so SSO org owners can add billing or receive a temporary trial credit.

Maria: Good to hear — marking this thread for follow-up. :thumbsup:
